execution.description: Invoked the repository canonical wrapper for the challenge-neutral scoring, Cooling scoring and Cooling construction suites from the short Windows worktree path through WSL.

expected: The wrapper should recognize the linked worktree as the repository root and launch its isolated canonical Docker checkout.
observed: The wrapper refused before Docker launch because WSL Git did not treat the Windows-owned linked worktree as a safe repository, so `rev-parse` could not establish the root. No tests, image build, solver, pod or spend occurred.
keep: Keep the canonical wrapper's repository-root guard intact.
Treat a safe-directory identity refusal as setup, not as a test result.
change: Rerun with a command-scoped Git safe-directory setting for this exact worktree.
